module.name: Provisioner
module.changelog: *1.0.11* A resource can serve an uploaded file instead of a template -- firmware above all. Upload one on the resource and it is served exactly as stored, under the resource's filename; remove it and the resource is the template it was, text and all. There is no type to set: the file is the difference. Files are kept in ASTSPOOLDIR/repo, named after the resource id, and go when the resource or its profile does. serveConfig() is now serve(), and it answers a request with no MAC address in it -- a phone fetching firmware sends none -- from the uploaded files, matched by name across every profile *1.0.10* A provisioning log: one row per request the endpoint answered -- MAC, the file asked for, the status it was answered with and when -- written whether or not a client exists for the MAC. Read it at &tab=logs on the module page, or on a client's own Logs tab, which is narrowed by MAC and so shows what a phone was asking for before anybody wrote its client. Metadata only; the rendered configuration is never stored *1.0.8* A device is a client: the row pairing a MAC with a FreePBX device and a profile is named that everywhere -- &client=, a Clients tab, listClients/saveClient/deleteClient -- so "device" now only ever means the FreePBX device it points at. The table is oryk_provisioner_clients; nothing renames it for you, so rename it before upgrading *1.0.7* A profile no longer holds a template of its own: every file it serves is a resource, the main config included, named .cfg like any other. The profiles table drops its `template` column on upgrade and the text in it is not migrated -- copy anything you still want into a resource first *1.0.6* Adding and editing a device is a page of its own at &device=, the shape a profile already had, rather than a modal on the list *1.0.5* Profile resources: a profile serves the other files a phone asks it for -- -phone.cfg, -directory.xml and the rest -- each a filename and a template of its own, edited on a Resources tab of the profile *1.0.4* Unauthenticated device endpoint at modules/oryk_provisioner/provision.php: a phone fetches its config with ?mac=, no admin login, by bootstrapping FreePBX directly instead of going through config.php *1.0.3* Rendered configuration at ?display=oryk_provisioner&mac=&config=, with {{ }} placeholders filled in from the device, its extension and the profile *1.0.2* Devices and Profiles: a MAC address is associated with a FreePBX device and a profile, and a profile is a name and a block of configuration text *1.0.1* New
module.description: Provision and manage VoIP endpoints with standardized device configurations for softphones, Yealink, Polycom, Grandstream, and other supported devices. Generate configuration data in JSON, XML, key-value, and device-specific formats.
